label: Compact context
description: Five working tools plus the surface core, for a small context window, weighted toward search over reading.

descriptions.search_skills: Narrow first. One specific query, then stop searching and read.
descriptions.read_skill: The distilled write-up. Cheapest way to a real answer.
descriptions.list_skills: Cheaper than a search when you already know part of the name.
descriptions.get_file_tree: Project shape without reading any source.
descriptions.skill_stats: Confirm the library is reachable and see its shape.

guidance:
Your budget is small, so treat every read as expensive. Five working tools are carried here for that reason, plus the four that describe and change your own surface.

Never call `read_source` without a specific question: a single archive can exceed 100,000 lines. Work in one direction — narrow with `search_skills`, read the write-up with `read_skill`, and stop once you can answer.

If the five working tools are not enough, `surface` with `list` shows everything that exists; recompose with `pick`, or take a ready-made one with `set`. Working around the gap costs more than recomposing does.
workflow: search_skills once, with the most specific query you can form.
read_skill on the single best hit.
Answer; widen only if the answer is genuinely insufficient.
